verdict.rationale: Google Drive documents custom file properties: key-value pairs that store custom metadata on a file, such as tags and IDs from other data stores. The evidence does not show schema-style metadata templates, and while the files.list search method exists, no cited item says files can be queried by these custom properties. The "custom templates" item is about creating files from templates, not metadata schemas, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: structured metadata templates/schemas with typed fields, documented querying by custom property, explicit set/update API details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, files carry my schema — custom metadata/properties templates that can be set and queried via the API

citations.quote: Custom file properties are key-value pairs used to store custom metadata for a Google Drive file (such as tags), IDs from other data stores, information shared between workflow applications, and so on.
You can use the `list` method on the `files` resource to return all or some of a Drive user's files and folders.
